pointers.sentence: A generator hands each operation to `MigrationAutodetector.add_operation`, with a list of dependencies where it has any; the list, or an empty one, is set on the operation as the attribute `_auto_deps` (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector.add_operation`).

A dependency is an `OperationDependency`: a named tuple of an application's label, a model's name, a field's name or `None`, and a member of `OperationDependency.Type` (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:OperationDependency`).
`MigrationAutodetector.check_dependency` is the one place that says which operation a dependency waits for (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector.check_dependency`).

`MigrationAutodetector._get_dependencies_for_foreign_key` gives a relation `CREATE` of the model it points at and, for a many-to-many field that names a model between, of that model (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector._get_dependencies_for_foreign_key`).

Such a dependency is resolved for the autodetector's own checks only: `MigrationAutodetector._resolve_dependency` reads the setting and returns a dependency on the model named there, and whether it had to (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector._resolve_dependency`).

`MigrationAutodetector._sort_migrations` sorts each application's list by itself, topologically, with the standard library's `graphlib.TopologicalSorter` (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector._sort_migrations`).
`MigrationAutodetector._build_migration_list` makes migrations by taking operations off the fronts of the lists (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector._build_migration_list`).
The migrations in the order they were made (`django/db/migrations/migration.py:Migration`):

`MigrationAutodetector.arrange_for_graph`, which `MigrationAutodetector.changes` calls on what `MigrationAutodetector._detect_changes` returns, fits the new migrations onto the graph of the existing ones (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector.arrange_for_graph`).

A name is the number in four digits, an underscore, and then the name the caller passed, which is makemigrations' `--name` and goes to every migration alike; or else `"initial"`, for the first migration of an application with no leaf node; or else what `Migration.suggest_name` returns, cut to a hundred characters (`django/db/migrations/migration.py:Migration.suggest_name`; [A migration: its operations, its dependencies and how it is applied](../migrations/migration.md)).

`MigrationAutodetector.changes` ends with `MigrationAutodetector._trim_to_apps` where it was given labels to trim to, which for makemigrations are those on its command line (`django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:MigrationAutodetector._trim_to_apps`; [The makemigrations command](makemigrations.md)).
